issue_binding: SzeChunYiu/ORION#2139 Stage 2 (+ Stage 0 slots); SzeChunYiu/ORION-paper#49 A2 Phase 1
episode_unit: (family, model_identity); one action per episode; family-level state artifacts cached and reused across the family's instances

signals.S_PENDING_MULTIPLICITY: clean instance count of the family (campaign prereg families[].n)
signals.S_DECLARED_MATERIALIZATION_COST: sum over family instances of utf8_bytes(dataset_folder_tree) + utf8_bytes(dataset_preview), divided by 10000.0
signals.S_DECLARED_SERVE_EXCHANGE_RATE: 1.0 constant (FLAT pricing frozen for this campaign; menu retained unchanged)

policies.ONE_SIGNAL_STATE: A_STATE_MAX if S_PENDING_MULTIPLICITY >= theta_m else A_RETAIN_MINIMAL
policies.ONE_SIGNAL_REASON: A_REASON_MAX if S_FAMILY_DIFFICULTY_PRIOR >= theta_d else A_RETAIN_MINIMAL
policies.ADAPTIVE: S=[v>=theta_v], R=[S_FAMILY_DIFFICULTY_PRIOR>=theta_r]; A_BALANCED if S and R; A_STATE_MAX if S; A_REASON_MAX if R; else A_RETAIN_MINIMAL

threshold_fitting.candidate_grid: midpoints between consecutive sorted tuning-family values of the relevant signal, plus one candidate below the minimum and one above the maximum
threshold_fitting.objective: maximize the policy's mean tuning-family score; ties toward the smaller threshold
threshold_fitting.adaptive_fit_order: theta_v then theta_r, each by the same grid rule, jointly re-checked by exhaustive grid product
threshold_fitting.stronger_one_signal_selection: higher mean tuning score; tie -> ONE_SIGNAL_STATE (declared before outcomes)

terminal_step.auxiliary_block_rule: concatenation, in fixed order, of whichever intermediate artifacts the action produced (family state artifact, instance state artifact, plan 1, plan 2), each under a neutral header naming neither the arm nor the action; empty string for A_RETAIN_MINIMAL
terminal_step.output_contract: single fenced Python block; the program is executed by the pinned upstream evaluator

scoring.instance_outcome: primary task-success boolean of the pinned upstream ScienceAgentBench evaluator (OSU-NLP-Group/ScienceAgentBench @ c26e151ed601ba109dc4d35e057ff8e73fec469d)
scoring.family_score: 100.0 * mean(instance successes) per (arm, model); normalized points = percentage points
scoring.hindsight_oracle: per (family, model): max over the four actions of the family score
scoring.execution_shape: 4-action matrix executed once per (instance, model); arm scores derived by policy lookup, never re-run

gold_isolation.note: output_fname is part of the task statement (where to save results) and carries no gold content; evaluation happens only in the upstream evaluator

probed_candidate_lanes_2026_09_02.GPT_CLASS: codex CLI (operator ChatGPT subscription), single-turn exec, tools disabled
probed_candidate_lanes_2026_09_02.CLAUDE_OR_GEMINI_CLASS: claude CLI (operator claude.ai subscription), -p print mode, tools disabled

model_identity_slots.decoding_note: CLI lanes expose no temperature control; provider-default decoding recorded as non-configurable; 1-run-per-cell repeat policy (campaign prereg) carries the consequence

execution_host_rule: laptop-billy or a LUNARC compute node; never the Mac mini; sealed pre-run manifest (Stage 3) binds all digests first

result_assembly.unseal_rule: protected_outcomes_unsealed set true only by the post-run assembly step on the execution host
result_assembly.cannot_check_rule: missing model class, missing family, or scope shortfall assembles a CANNOT_CHECK posture; silent narrowing forbidden

successor_rule: editing any frozen value here after any protected model call is forbidden; a successor requires its own preregistration
